designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service established the Oahu Forest National Wildlife Refuge in the northern Koolau Mountains by buying a 4,525-acre parcel from Castle and Cooke to protect native forest and endangered forest birds such as the Oahu elepaio.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by land purchase (U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service)

designationHistory.note: The Star-Bulletin (Dec. 22, 2000) says the deed changed hands 'yesterday,' that is, December 21, 2000; FWS gives only the year.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Invasive Plant Prioritization Workshop Report: Oahu Forest NWR (2024): established in 2000
